summary: The regional means are weighted; the open issues are a small cluster count, disclosed in the note, and an unexplained weighted regression.

findings.title: Twenty clusters with conventional CRVE

evidence.claim: Clustered standard errors with 20 clusters can be too small.
evidence.found: vcov = ~state_code over 20 states; the note discloses the limitation.
evidence.verified_by: Counted distinct state_code values in data/example/states.csv: 20.

findings.fix: Report a wild cluster bootstrap p-value beside the clustered one.

findings.title: Regression weights stated without a rationale

evidence.claim: The weighted regression gives no reason for weighting.
evidence.found: No comment or draft text explains why the regression is weighted.
evidence.verified_by: Searched the script and drafts for a rationale.

findings.refutation: Checked whether weighted and unweighted estimates are shown to agree; they are not shown.
